name: Laptop Thermal Stability Pack

game_settings: Frame rate cap: 60 FPS or monitor refresh rate (prevent unnecessary heat)
VSync: Consider ON to cap framerate naturally
Resolution: Native or slight reduction if thermals critical
Demanding effects: Reduce shadows, reflections, ambient occlusion
os_settings: Windows Power Plan: Balanced (NOT High Performance for laptops)
Processor power management: Maximum processor state = 90-95% (prevents turbo boost heat)
Minimum processor state: 5% (allows downclocking when idle)
Laptop lid: Keep open for better airflow
driver_settings: GPU Power Management: Optimal Power (not Maximum)
AMD Chill: Enable to cap FPS dynamically
Battery Boost: Disable if plugged in, enable on battery
background_processes: Close unnecessary background apps to reduce CPU load
Monitor temperatures with HWInfo64 or MSI Afterburner (optional)
optiplay_tools: FPS Booster - Laptop Profile with frame cap
Custom FPS cap guide per game

does_not_modify: CPU voltage (no undervolting without user consent)
Fan curves (requires BIOS or OEM software)
revert_steps: Windows Power Plan: Back to Balanced (default laptop setting)
Processor power management: Reset maximum state to 100%
GPU driver settings: Reset to defaults
hardware_recommendations: Use laptop on hard, flat surface (not bed/couch)
Elevate laptop with stand or books for better airflow
Consider laptop cooling pad for sustained sessions
Clean dust from vents every 3-6 months
Repaste thermal compound every 1-2 years (advanced users)
warnings: Reducing max CPU state will lower absolute performance but increase sustained performance
Some thin-and-light laptops will always throttle under heavy load (by design)
This preset trades peak FPS for consistency
If temps exceed 95°C, stop gaming and check cooling system
notes: Laptops are thermally constrained by design. This preset prevents thermal throttling by reducing sustained heat generation rather than chasing maximum FPS. Ideal for gaming laptops, ultrabooks, and thin-and-light devices.
